messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

If you put too much milk
and sugar in your coffee,
just think of it as milk
tea when you drink it!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kui paned kohvi liiga
palju piima ja suhkrut,
mõtle, et see on
piimatee!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I'm making a daily diary
of what I eat. Did I really
chow 17 chocolate waffles
yesterday?! URP!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Pean päevikut sellest,
mida söön. Kas sõin eile
tõesti 17 šokolaadi-
vahvlit?! ÖÄK!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

To make food look more
appealing, use a nice dish
and arrange the plate
well! It's cheap and easy!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Et toit isuäratavam
paistaks, kasuta ilusat
taldrikut ja sea toit
kenasti! Odav ja lihtne!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

My sister keeps buying big
cakes and eating them all.
I wish she'd share with
me! I {00 00 00} cake!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Mu õde ostab suuri kooke
ja sööb need üksi ära.
Soovin, et ta jagaks!
Ma {00 00 00} kooki!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

Today's daily riddle: Needs
no shoes, has a tail, can
be found in a garden pail.
Oh! I forgot the answer!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Tänane mõistatus: kingi
ei vaja, saba on, leiad
aiaämbrist. Oh! Unustasin
vastuse ära!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

When you're sad, throw a
few balls down the lanes
of your soul. I threw 3
strikes the other day! {00 01 00}
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kui oled kurb, veereta
paar palli oma hinge
rajal. Mina viskasin
eile 3 straiki! {00 01 00}

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 

There's someone in this
town whose face makes me
crave spicy curry! ...No,
I WON'T tell you who it is!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Selles linnas on keegi,
kelle nägu paneb mind
vürtsikat karrit ihkama!
...Ei, ma EI ütle, kes!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 

When I count money at the
town hall, people always
ask if I like my job.
It makes me kind of sad.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kui ma raekojas raha
loen, küsivad inimesed
alati, kas mulle töö
meeldib. See teeb kurvaks.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 

I just saw this movie
where two hedgehogs fell
in love! The ending was so
cliche! Bah! Unbelievable.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Nägin just filmi, kus
kaks siili armusid!
Lõpp oli nii klišeelik!
Pöh! Uskumatu.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 

Who was it that decided 
some things "shouldn't be
seen"? I'll see what I
want! ...Unless it's GROSS!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kes otsustas, et mõnda
asja ei tohi näha?
Mina vaatan, mida tahan!
...Kui see just jälk pole!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 

My sister said, "Your tea
tastes like sludge!"
I'm never making tea for
her again. What a grump!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Mu õde ütles: sinu tee
maitseb nagu muda!
Ei tee talle enam iial
teed. Milline tuiger!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 

I just found out that my 
sister's been pawning her
work off on me. She owes
me a thank-you gift!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Sain teada, et õde on
oma tööd mulle kaela
määrinud. Ta võlgneb
mulle tänukingi!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 

I'm thinking about what to
send my dad for his next
birthday... Maybe he wants
a big cookie! Yummy!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Mõtlen, mida isale
järgmiseks sünnipäevaks
saata... Ehk tahab ta
suurt küpsist! Nämm!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 

I loved homing pigeons as
a kid. It would be fun to
get paid for delivering
letters to folks!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Lapsena armastasin tuvisid.
Oleks lõbus saada palka
kirjade kandmise eest!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 

When I see my sister 
talking to Pete, it makes
me feel kinda strange...
Must be something I ate.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kui näen oma õde Petega
rääkimas, on mul veider
tunne... Vist sõin
midagi paha.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

You don't ever really talk
to yourself when you're 
alone, do you? Nah, I'd
never do that... Oops!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Sa ei räägi ju kunagi
üksi olles iseendaga,
eks? Ei, mina ei teeks
seda iial... Oih!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 

We are alive because we 
have big hearts, right?
...So what about bugs?
Do they have tiny hearts?
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Me oleme elus, sest meil
on suur süda, eks?
...Aga putukad? Kas neil
on pisikesed südamed?

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 

Try to get your work done
swiftly and efficiently.
But don't work too fast,
or you'll go crazy!!!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Tee töö kiiresti ja
tõhusalt ära. Aga mitte
liiga kiiresti, muidu
lähed hulluks!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 

What do you think of the
name Pelly? I prefer more
distinctive names...
Like Pellina! Or Pelliford!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Mida arvad nimest Pelly?
Mina eelistan eripärasemaid
nimesid... Näiteks
Pellina! Või Pelliford!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 

I wonder why "bad boys" 
always wear sunglasses?
I bet it's because they
actually cry a lot. Babies!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Miks pahad poisid kannavad
alati prille? Kindlasti
sellepärast, et nad
tegelikult palju nutavad!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 

Is it a bad thing to make
copies or serve coffee?
I kinda like it, actually,
so why stop now?!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kas koopiate tegemine või
kohvi pakkumine on halb?
Mulle päriselt meeldib,
miks siis lõpetada?!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 

I wear a bathing suit in
the tub, in case of an
earthquake. Maybe I
watch too much TV.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Käin vannis trikoos,
maavärina puhuks.
Ehk vaatan liiga
palju telekat.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself- 
 
Really small things are
called mobile, right? So
what about mobile homes?
That's kind of weird.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Väikseid asju kutsutakse
mobiilseteks, eks?
Aga mobiilsed majad?
See on pisut veider.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

Wondering why I post my
thoughts here? ...I guess
I'm curious what other
people think.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Miks ma oma mõtteid siia
panen? ...Vist olen
uudishimulik, mida
teised arvavad.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

When I was little, kids
called me the librarian,
but I'm not a librarian!
Kids can be so cruel...
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Lapsena kutsuti mind
raamatukoguhoidjaks,
aga ma pole seda!
Lapsed on julmad...

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

They say worms wriggle,
but what does that really
mean? Wriggle, wriggle,
wriggle! Tee hee hee!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Öeldakse, et ussid
vingerdavad, aga mida see
tähendab? Vingerda!
Hi-hi-hii!

messages.en:
-Talking to Pete's Self-

Check your mail daily!
If your mailbox is full,
we can't deliver letters.
Help us help you!
messages.et:
-Pete iseendaga rääkides-

Kontrolli postkasti iga
päev! Kui kast on täis,
ei saa me kirju kohale
tuua. Aita meid!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

What's worse? Running
from a problem before it
starts or leaving in the
middle? Just curious.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Mis on hullem? Probleemi
eest põgeneda enne algust
või keset pooleli jätta?
Niisama huvitav.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I wonder about these guys
who watch TV all day. Of
course, I shouldn't talk!
I watch TV every night!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Imestan nende üle, kes
vaatavad terve päeva
telekat. Muidugi ei tohiks
ma rääkida! Vaatan ka!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

If you're nervous about
going somewhere for the
first time, pretend you're
an old lady. Works for me!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kui kardad kuhugi
esimest korda minna,
teeskle, et oled vana
proua. Minul toimib!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

If you want to make my
sister mad, just cut her
bread really thin.
She hates that!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kui tahad mu õde vihaseks
ajada, lõika tema leib
väga õhukeseks.
Ta vihkab seda!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I wonder if my sister
intentionally leaves the
curtain out of the tub
just to make me mad?
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Huvitav, kas mu õde jätab
kardina meelega vanni
kõrvale, et mind
vihaseks ajada?

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

Blathers says that the
problem with me is that
I'm too right-brained.
Who knew he was a lefty?!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Blathers ütleb, et minu
häda on liigne parema
ajupoole kasutamine.
Kes teadis!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

When I was in middle
school, I was on the
volleyball team. Receive!
Set! Spike! I miss it.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Põhikoolis mängisin
võrkpalli. Vastuvõtt!
Sööt! Rünnak!
Igatsen seda.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I'm very popular in the 
kids' section of the
library... Sigh...
Oh, Pete...
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Olen raamatukogu
lasteosakonnas väga
populaarne... Ohh...
Oh, Pete...

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

Does toilet paper become 
cuter when a design is
added to it? Mine is
covered with puppies!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kas tualettpaber muutub
nunnumaks, kui sellel on
muster? Minu omal on
kutsikad!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

If local folks came with
instruction manuals, I'd
want one for my sister
and about five for Pete!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kui inimestega tuleksid
kasutusjuhendid, tahaksin
ühte oma õe kohta ja
viit Pete kohta!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I love pop music, but I
can't understand what 
they're saying!
"Doo wop bop?" Huh?
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Armastan popmuusikat, aga
ei saa aru, mida nad
laulavad! Duu vop bop?
Ah?

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

Do you want to know what
my base salary is? I can't
tell you exactly, but
there are lots of zeroes!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Tahad teada, kui suur on
mu põhipalk? Täpselt ei
ütle, aga seal on
palju nulle!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

What color should I dye
my feathers? Red is too
bright. Blue makes me
look sick. Maybe I won't.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Mis värvi peaksin suled
värvima? Punane on liiga
ere. Sinine teeb haigeks.
Ehk jätan tegemata.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

How many cherry tomatoes
is enough? Three? Twelve?
No, that's too many.
Maybe I'll try four.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kui palju kirsstomateid
on piisav? Kolm? Kaksteist?
Ei, see on liiga palju.
Proovin nelja.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

Things that are hard or
difficult are more fun
when you do them with
samba music! Try it!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Rasked asjad on lõbusamad,
kui teed neid samba
saatel! Proovi järele!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

Have you ever eaten
"Swamp Delight"? Not me!
I don't see how THAT
could taste good!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kas oled söönud soo
hõrgutist? Mina mitte!
Ei kujuta ette, kuidas
SEE hea maitseb!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

Pinecones fall from trees,
but they aren't fruit.
That's why pine trees
are my favorite plants!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Käbid kukuvad puult, aga
pole puuviljad. Seepärast
on männid mu
lemmiktaimed!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

Hip hop hippity hop...
Hip hop hippity hop...
That song is popular in
every town but mine! Boo!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Hip hop hipiti hop...
Hip hop hipiti hop...
See laul on populaarne
igas linnas peale meie!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

Katrina told me that the 
pelican was the symbol
for savings. I'm not sure
how I feel about that.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Katrina ütles, et pelikan
on säästmise sümbol.
Ei tea, mida ma
sellest arvan.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

If you know someone nice,
introduce him to me! I'm
single, ya know!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kui tead mõnda toredat
inimest, tutvusta teda
mulle! Olen vallaline!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I don't mean to brag or 
anything, but I'm both 
cute AND smart! So why
am I still single?
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Ei taha kiidelda, aga ma
olen nii nunnu KUI ka
tark! Miks ma siis veel
vallaline olen?

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I'm terrible at directions!
I need one of those car
navigation systems hung
around my neck.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Mul on kohutav suunataju!
Vajaksin navigaatorit
kaela riputamiseks.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I work very hard, but I
also enjoy my free time!
I'm young, cute, and
single! Hint, hint!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Töötan kõvasti, aga naudin
ka vaba aega! Olen noor,
nunnu ja vallaline!
Vihje, vihje!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I just ate some candy
with the same amount of
vitamin C as 300 lemons...
I'm covered for life!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Sõin just komme, milles
on sama palju C-vitamiini
kui 300 sidrunis...
Olen eluks ajaks kaetud!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

My sister likes to pig out
before bed. She can chow
down 7 or 8 donuts in one
sitting... It's impressive!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Mu õde armastab enne und
kõhtu täis süüa.
Ta vitsutab 7-8 sõõrikut
korraga... Muljetavaldav!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

Sitting on a hot wharf...
gazing into nothingness...
Fishing is boring! I just
don't get it!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Istud kuumal kail...
vahid tühjusesse...
Kalapüük on igav!
Ma lihtsalt ei mõista!

messages.en:
-Poetry-

Just one bite won't hurt
Yum bite gobble gobble
Yum
I ate twelve cupcakes
messages.et:
-Luule-

Üks amps ei tee halba
Nämm amps mugi mugi
Nämm
Sõin kaksteist koogikest

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

When she was younger, my
sister loved airplanes.
She'd put slippers on her
open wings and fly!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Noorena armastas mu õde
lennukeid. Ta pani sussid
laiali tiibadele
ja lendas!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I can't tell which talk
show is real and which one
is fake...and if I don't
know, I don't wanna watch!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Ma ei tea, milline jutusaade
on päris ja milline mitte...
ja kui ei tea, ei taha
vaadatagi!

messages.en:
-Poetry-

I prefer my jelly rolls
moist and rich and cakey.
But yesterday, I ate a
roll that was all dry!
messages.et:
-Luule-

Eelistan rulaadi niisket
ja rammusat. Aga eile
sõin rulaadi, mis oli
läbinisti kuiv!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

It's odd how even the
chattiest people get
quiet in elevators!
Except for my sister...
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Imelik, kuidas isegi kõige
jutukamad inimesed liftis
vaikivad! Välja arvatud
mu õde...

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I really envy comedians.
Even when they don't feel
like laughing, they make
other people laugh.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kadestan koomikuid. Isegi
kui neil naeru ei tule,
panevad nad teisi
naerma.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I heard that really orange
eye shadow and pink gloss
are must-haves! I gotta
read more Ms. Nintendique!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kuulsin, et ere oranž
lauvärv ja roosa läige on
hädavajalikud! Pean rohkem
ajakirju lugema!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

Wish from your heart, and
it's sure to come true...
But sometimes not quite.
That's how fate works.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Soovi südamest ja see
läheb kindlasti täide...
Aga vahel mitte päris.
Nii saatus toimib.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

As a kid, I always wanted
to have picnics by myself.
But then I got lonely, so
I stopped. Too bad...
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Lapsena tahtsin alati
üksinda piknikut pidada.
Aga jäin üksildaseks
ja lõpetasin. Kahju...

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I've always washed my own
lunchbox, and my sister's,
too. Siiiiigh! Some things
never change!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Olen alati pesnud oma
lõunakarpi ja ka õe oma.
Ohhh! Mõni asi ei
muutu kunagi!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

Classical music... Allegro
is faster, andante is laid
back, and al dente is the
only way to cook pasta.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Klassikaline muusika...
Allegro on kiirem, andante
rahulik ja al dente on
ainus viis pastat keeta.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

There's a kind of spicy
chili pepper called The
Birdseye... I'm really
scared of it!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

On olemas vürtsikas
tšillipipar nimega
Linnusilm... Ma kardan
seda päriselt!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

My sister's been going to
hotels lately, so one day
I followed her. She was
eating the free buffet!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Mu õde käib viimasel ajal
hotellides, nii et ühel
päeval järgnesin talle.
Ta sõi tasuta Rootsi lauas!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I filled an empty water
bottle with ordinary
tap water and... PRESTO!
Homemade water!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Täitsin tühja veepudeli
tavalise kraaniveega
ja... VOILÀ! Omatehtud
vesi!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

The other day my sister 
baked me a cake. It was
disgusting! AND shaped
like a bug!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Õde küpsetas mulle
hiljuti koogi. See oli
vastik! JA putuka
kujuline!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

How can salsa be a kind
of dance, a kind of music,
AND a kind of dip? It's
the miracle word!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kuidas saab salsa olla
tants, muusika JA kaste?
See on imesõna!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

If something can sit
vertically or horizontally,
I always set it
horizontally. Safety first!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kui midagi saab panna
püsti või pikali, panen
alati pikali.
Ohutus ennekõike!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

Why is eight afraid of
seven? Because seven ate
nine! Get it? Ate? Eight?
WAH HA HA HA HA HA!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Miks kaheksa kardab
seitset? Sest seitse sõi
üheksa! Said aru?
VAH-HAH-HAH-HAA!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

"DON'T DO THIS, MAN!"
That was a line in a movie
I saw... I hope I can say
that someday!
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

ÄRA TEE SEDA, MEES!
See oli repliik filmist,
mida nägin... Loodan, et
kunagi saan seda öelda!

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I want to get my
driver's license. Then I
can take my boyfriend for
a ride in my convertible.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Tahan juhiluba teha.
Siis saan oma kallimat
kabrioletiga sõidutada.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

I write down everything
I want and then cross
it off the list when I
get it! It's a big list.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kirjutan üles kõik, mida
tahan, ja tõmban maha,
kui selle saan!
See on pikk nimekiri.

messages.en:
-Talking to Myself-

If my life were a comic,
I'd be in the 2nd or 3rd
issue. It'd be a romance!
My sister's would be sad.
messages.et:
-Iseendaga rääkides-

Kui mu elu oleks koomiks,
